releases.title: Online MCQ tests
notes: Teachers can design and publish MCQ tests with start time, duration and marks.
Students verify their details, take the test on time, and see correct and wrong answers after submitting.
Test reports are visible to the student, the parents and the teacher.

releases.title: Notifications and profile editing
notes: Notification bell on the student and parent dashboards. A blinking red dot means a new notice or update.
Edit your profile with the pencil icon. Parent changes are approved by the tuition office first.
Login Activity: delete one record, or clear them all.
Mother's name now shows in the child profile.

features.title: Notifications
features.text: New notices and app updates show up here. A blinking red dot means something new.

features.title: Edit your child's profile
